trigger: any gate, action-observation, causality, or sink stage rejects or blocks
steps: Freeze the terminal classification and strongest actually observed proof level.
Record the failed stage, failed rule/check IDs, run/action/correlation identity, and artifact paths without raw sensitive payloads.
Do not emit or retain a success successor for a rejected chain.
Select the owning repair workflow or validator from the codebase map; do not substitute generic advice or agent reinterpretation.
Emit cascade-final-handoff with one executable next command and require a fresh complete gate sequence after repair.
invariants: Input rejection is not an action failure because the action was never authorized.
Missing action observation is BLOCKED_ACTION_NOT_OBSERVED, not a semantic result failure.
Post-gate rejection preserves the action observation but forbids success propagation.
Agent narrative cannot promote or rename a deterministic terminal classification.
proofCeiling: Failure identity, strongest observed proof, and deterministic continuation contract only.
